svg.aria-label: Computation graph of the guide's example. Data x = 2 and parameter w = 1 enter a multiplication giving wx = 2; adding parameter b = 0 gives the prediction ŷ = 2; subtracting the target y = 6 gives −4; squaring gives the loss L = 16. The backward pass runs right to left: the derivative of L is 1 at the loss, 2(ŷ − y) = −8 after the square, −8 through the subtraction and the addition, so ∂L/∂b = −8, and multiplied by x = 2 at the multiplication, so ∂L/∂w = −16. The gradient is (−16, −8).
svg.text: the gradient: one derivative per parameter
